messages:
Maya L: heads up — since ~11:03 UTC we've had sustained queue_depth >150 on ml-serving-prod (west1). latency creeping too. autoscaler did not add capacity, Grafana alert didn't fire. link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/xyz/ml-serving-prod

Leo P: Checking logs now. I see the autoscaler requested scale-up but the provider returned 403/QuotaExceeded for GPU SKU. region-west1 reported available=0 for p4d-like. Autoscaler gave up after 3 retries.

Sasha R: ugh. That explains the no-scale. Can you paste the autoscaler error lines? Also pinging @infra-bot to surface quota dashboard.

Leo P: logs snippet: `ERROR autoscaler: nodegroup add failed: quotaExceeded: GPUs requested=2, available=0 (region-west1)`

Maya L: Grafana panel for "svc:queue_depth" shows a ~20m plateau. The alert is configured as `queue_depth > 200 for 10m` which is too high for batch-sensitive workloads. We should tune to 120 for 5m maybe.

Jonah: Agree on lowering threshold. Also propose an additional headroom alert: percent_gpu_headroom < 15% for 5m. Current is 5% for 2m which triggers too late. Example PromQL to compute headroom:```promql
100 * (sum(node_gpu_capacity_total) - sum(node_gpu_allocated)) / sum(node_gpu_capacity_total)
```

Sasha R: nice. Also add a panel that shows `scale_failures{reason="quota"}` over time so we can correlate. And add a per-region capacity heatmap.

Ash K: cost note: increasing min replicas to avoid this will raise monthly spend. Suggest temporary short-term mitigations: 1) enable cross-region fallback routing for non-PII inference traffic, 2) opportunistic use of quantized model variant (lower GPU memory) when headroom < 20%. Both require small code + infra changes but cheaper than permanently bigger fleet.

Maya L: +1 to fallback. We should also run a smoke autoscale test in a staging region to replicate the failure mode. Steps: a) reduce min nodes to current prod min, b) run synthetic ramp to 3x request rate, c) verify autoscaler adds nodes and no quota error (if quota error happens, test will reveal it).

Leo P: I'll run the staging smoke test in ~30m and will tail `autoscaler-controller` logs. If quota error appears, ops runbook should have next steps to request quota bump with cloud team.

infra-bot: New incident ticket created: INC-2026-1143 — "west1 GPU quota causing autoscale fail". Assigned to @Leo P and @Ash K. Priority: P2.

Jonah: Action items captured: - update queue_depth alert to 120/5m - add percent_gpu_headroom alert 15%/5m - add scale_failures-by-reason panel - run staging smoke test and share logs - add fallback routing + quantized variant plan (cost estimate)

Maya L: I'll update the runbook with the new thresholds and link the incident. tagging @SRE oncall in case this escalates :thumbsup:

Leo P: test started. tailing logs now. will post results in this thread when done. :zap:
